name: solidworks-automation-skill
description: Local Windows MCP server for controlled SolidWorks, CAD Studio, DFM, routing, FEA, and open-format CAD automation.
long_description: SolidWorks Automation Skill exposes a local stdio MCP server for Windows desktop CAD workflows. It provides guarded SolidWorks COM tools for parts, assemblies, drawings, exports, reviews, mates, holes, Motion Study checks, and batch delivery, plus headless CAD Studio tools for open-format generation, DFM checks, routing review, FEA preparation, and geometry preflight. Native SolidWorks tools require a local licensed SolidWorks installation; headless open-format tools can run without SolidWorks where their Python dependencies are available.

tools.name: cadstudio_write_open_format
tools.description: Write controlled open-format CAD artifacts from a NeutralCadDocument without launching SolidWorks.

tools.name: cadstudio_build_dxf_preview_scene
tools.description: Convert a DXF file into a safe preview scene without overwriting existing output.

tools.name: cadstudio_check_dfm
tools.description: Run lightweight DFM checks for machining, sheet metal, laser cutting, or 3D printing inputs.

tools.name: cadstudio_check_routing
tools.description: Review neutral routing endpoints, segments, bend radius, clearance, supports, and routing BOM data.

tools.name: cadstudio_routing_preflight
tools.description: Probe local SOLIDWORKS Routing evidence such as type libraries, add-ins, and license indicators.

tools.name: cadstudio_fea_preflight
tools.description: Detect supported local FEA solvers without executing arbitrary commands.

tools.name: cadstudio_prepare_fea
tools.description: Generate a controlled CalculiX input deck from a structured FEA request.

tools.name: cadstudio_run_fea
tools.description: Run a whitelisted CalculiX static analysis and parse displacement, stress, and convergence evidence.

tools.name: cadstudio_run_fea_convergence
tools.description: Run a bounded mesh convergence study and compare final displacement and stress deltas.

tools.name: cadstudio_review_advanced_geometry
tools.description: Validate advanced surface or mold geometry plans and return pilot or blocked gate evidence.

tools.name: cadstudio_create_ocp_loft
tools.description: Create a restricted OpenCascade loft and emit STEP, BREP, STL, and validation evidence.

tools.name: cadstudio_create_ocp_surface
tools.description: Create restricted loft, sweep, knit, or thicken geometry and return continuity evidence.

tools.name: solidworks_health_check
tools.description: Check Python dependencies, SolidWorks detection, optional live connection, and Motion type library status.

tools.name: solidworks_connect
tools.description: Connect to or start a local SolidWorks desktop session and summarize the active document.

tools.name: solidworks_new_document
tools.description: Create a new SolidWorks part, assembly, or drawing document.

tools.name: solidworks_create_basic_part
tools.description: Create a guarded basic box or cylinder part with optional save path and appearance.

tools.name: solidworks_open_document
tools.description: Open an existing SolidWorks part, assembly, or drawing document.

tools.name: solidworks_add_component
tools.description: Add a component to the active assembly with placement and optional fixed state.

tools.name: solidworks_set_component_fixed
tools.description: Fix or float assembly components selected by name keyword.

tools.name: solidworks_save_document
tools.description: Save or save-as the active SolidWorks document.

tools.name: solidworks_close_documents
tools.description: Close the active document or all documents, with explicit discard semantics.

tools.name: solidworks_add_coincident_mate
tools.description: Add a coincident mate between selected component reference geometry.

tools.name: solidworks_add_distance_mate
tools.description: Add a distance mate between selected component reference geometry.

tools.name: solidworks_add_concentric_mate
tools.description: Add a concentric mate by matching cylindrical faces within radius ranges.

tools.name: solidworks_set_appearance
tools.description: Set document or component appearance color in the active SolidWorks session.

tools.name: solidworks_export_active
tools.description: Export the active SolidWorks document to STEP, STL, IGES, Parasolid, PDF, or DXF.

tools.name: solidworks_update_dimension
tools.description: Update a named dimension in millimeters and return rebuild and save evidence.

tools.name: solidworks_set_custom_properties
tools.description: Write and verify file-level or configuration-level custom properties.

tools.name: solidworks_batch_export_files
tools.description: Batch open and export multiple SolidWorks files to selected delivery formats.

tools.name: solidworks_export_assembly_bom
tools.description: Export an assembly component and property BOM to CSV with review evidence.

tools.name: solidworks_pack_and_go
tools.description: Run native SolidWorks Pack and Go and verify packaged references.

tools.name: solidworks_review_active
tools.description: Export multi-view previews and a JSON review report for the active document.

tools.name: solidworks_generate_drawing
tools.description: Generate a controlled GB/T or ISO SolidWorks engineering drawing from a versioned DrawingSpec v1 JSON file.

tools.name: solidworks_review_drawing
tools.description: Review a SolidWorks engineering drawing against DrawingSpec layout, dimensions, hole requirements, PDF text, and preview evidence.

tools.name: solidworks_inspect_drawing
tools.description: Inspect SolidWorks drawing sheets, views, dimensions, notes, tables, and preview evidence without changing the drawing.

tools.name: solidworks_create_hole_feature
tools.description: Create blind, through, counterbore, countersink, or semicircular slot features.

tools.name: solidworks_inspect_hole_features
tools.description: Inspect B-Rep hole segments, compound holes, slot arcs, and hole positions.

tools.name: solidworks_add_rotary_motor
tools.description: Create a Motion Study and add a constant-speed rotary motor between shaft and rotor geometry.

tools.name: solidworks_inspect_motion_studies
tools.description: Inspect Motion Studies, motor or force counts, and result freshness.

tools.name: solidworks_validate_motion_study
tools.description: Validate Motion Study type, duration, motor count, result existence, and stale result status.
